policies.description: Any request to create or update a record must validate all mandatory fields before proceeding.
references: Mandatory Fields: Any request to create or update a record must validate all mandatory fields.

policies.policy_name: Role‑Based Access Control for Update Operations
policies.description: Only users whose role grants Full CRUD permission on the relevant tables may update an incident template. Administrators have Full CRUD on all tables; Managers have Full CRUD on operational tables such as incident, problem, change, and knowledge.
references: | Administrator (admin) | System Configuration & Integrity | Full CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) access across all tables. |
| Manager (manager) | Supervision, Escalation, Approvals | Full CRUD on operational tables (incident, problem, change, knowledge); READ access to all the tables. |

policies.policy_name: Verify Existing Record ID Before Update
policies.description: The incident_template_id supplied to the update operation must correspond to an existing incident template; IDs must never be fabricated.
references: Never assume or fabricate IDs, responses, or outcomes — rely solely on verified API results.

policies.description: The update_incident_template call must be performed as a single validated operation; no additional actions may be combined unless using an approved batch endpoint.
references: Atomic Operations: Perform one validated operation at a time, except when using approved batch endpoints.

policies.policy_name: Require At Least One Non‑Empty Update Field
policies.description: When updating a record, at least one field other than the identifier must be provided with a non‑empty value; if a mandatory field is missing, the missing field must be reported.
references: User Clarification: Do not ask for further information. If the request is ambiguous, return the list and state the ambiguity. If a mandatory field is missing, state which field is required.
